name: helpdesk-backend
description: Government Help Desk Management System API

scripts.use:xampp: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); let c=fs.readFileSync('.env','utf8').replace(/^DB_TARGET=\w+/m, 'DB_TARGET=xampp'); fs.writeFileSync('.env', c); console.log('✅ Switched DB_TARGET=xampp in .env');"
scripts.use:docker: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); let c=fs.readFileSync('.env','utf8').replace(/^DB_TARGET=\w+/m, 'DB_TARGET=docker'); fs.writeFileSync('.env', c); console.log('✅ Switched DB_TARGET=docker in .env');"
